label: Wordmark text
name: wordmark_text
help_text: The large serif text in the header (e.g. ATRI).

label: Navigation menu
name: menu
help_text: Select a HubSpot advanced menu for the nav bar.

label: Search API base URL
name: search_api_base
help_text: Base URL of the ATRI Search API, with no trailing slash (e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com). The module calls {base}/api/search/.

label: Results per page
name: search_per_page
help_text: How many results to request per search (1–100).
